versions.changelog: v1.0.0: hands-on compliance playbook for labeling AI-generated synthetic content - China Measures (mandatory 2025-09-01, explicit+implicit dual labeling, platform four-step verification, app-store review) and EU AI Act Article 50 (mandatory 2026-08-02, machine-readable marks, deepfake labeling, chatbot disclosure, up to EUR 15M/3%); practical labeling for text/image/audio/video/virtual scenes, metadata and watermarking options, CN-EU reuse strategy, 8-step remediation; 5-command zero-dependency toolkit
